one_liner: Senior Pentagon analyst overseeing DoD maritime munitions acquisition programs: cost, schedule, risk, budget reviews, and congressional/GAO responses.
fit_summary: This role requires a year at GS-13 level directing acquisition oversight for major defense programs, and you must be able to obtain SCI eligibility. Daniel's resume has no defense acquisition or weapons-program work, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens) under Direct Hire Authority; no federal status needed, but veterans' preference is applied as a positive factor.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-13 covering: end-to-end acquisition oversight of a major defense portfolio, weapons systems, or critical technology programs; evaluating acquisition strategies, baselines, and milestone documentation; and leading cross-functional teams across military service staffs and oversight bodies.
Must be able to obtain and keep a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance.
Education cannot substitute for experience, and qualifications must be met by the November 4, 2026 closing date.
Resume limited to two pages, with months and hours per week listed for each job.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows no federal acquisition oversight or weapons-program work.
Consider entry points that fit him better, such as GS-11/12 program analyst roles, lower-band AcqDemo roles at DoD, or FEMA positions.
resume_bullets: Tracked spending and order status in Excel pivot-table reports for multi-state COVID-19 purchasing (2021–2022).
